title: pair
description: Pair a new device with the active PIN (unauthenticated sessions only, 5 attempts per connection). Success authenticates the connection. Carries the client info like auth. It is checked before the PIN: a too old app yields upgrade_required + close 4426 without consuming the PIN; invalid client info yields pair_error.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version the app speaks. Missing or below the hub's min_protocol_version: the hub answers upgrade_required and closes 4426.

app_version.description: Below min_app_version[platform] of the hub: upgrade_required, close 4426.
